Canada and Switzerland SVGs retrieved from https://flagcdn.com/ca.svg and
https://flagcdn.com/ch.svg on November 10, 2026. Real flag artwork is used to
check complete rendering of wide and square flags without network requests.
Source: https://flagpedia.net/download/api.

Qatar (`qa.svg`), Vatican City (`va.svg`) and Sri Lanka (`lk.svg`) retrieved
November 14, 2026 from the matching https://flagcdn.com/{code}.svg URLs.
They extend the native-proportion checks to very wide, square and detailed flags.
Artwork is kept intact, without conversion to a standard icon aspect ratio.
